zoe: FYI — customer Acme reporting 401 invalid_api_key after onboarding via Okta SSO. They clicked the org SSO 'Create API key' flow in the dashboard and pasted the value into their service. Happening across multiple hosts. Repro steps below.

zoe: Repro (from their machine)
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sso_eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1...' \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
{"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"key not found or expired"}
```

mason: Can you grab the request-id and org-id from logs? Also did they call hosted or a Dedicated endpoint?

zoe: Request-ID: r-0a1b2c3d4e Org: org-acme-42 Region: us-west-2 Endpoint: hosted. Model: redwood-large. I redacted full token, left prefix `sso_eyJ...`.

mason: Thanks. Quick note — we recently changed SSO keys to be short-lived JWTs that must be exchanged. If they paste the raw SSO token as an API key the runtime won't accept it and returns invalid_api_key.

mira: Confirmed — `sso_` prefix = ephemeral SSO token. The intended flow is: 1) client uses SSO handshake to get the SSO JWT, 2) call POST /v1/sso/exchange with that JWT to mint a long-lived API key (or get a session token) for service use. We intentionally reject sso_* tokens at the public endpoints for security.

zoe: Oh — customer followed an older onboarding snippet that only showed the SSO login step and the 'copy secret' button. We didn't show the exchange call. I'll tell them to call the exchange endpoint and rotate to the minted key.

mason: Can we surface a clearer error message? `invalid_api_key` is ambiguous for customers. Maybe return 401 with code `sso_token_requires_exchange` and guidance URL.

mira: Agreed. Filing IAM-312 to update runtime error and the onboarding docs. I'll add a quick banner in the dashboard flow too so users know the token in the UI is ephemeral unless they click 'mint long-lived key'.

deploy-bot: deploy redwood/console@prod rolled out 2024-12-05T17:23:42Z — UI banner change scheduled in next minor.

zoe: Great. I'll reply to Acme with repro steps and offer to rotate a long-lived key for them while docs land. :thumbsup:

mason: thanks — please include the request-id and exact curl output in the support ticket so we can trace on the infra side.

zoe: Will do, sending now and attaching logs.

mira: If you want a short workaround for them: exchange the SSO JWT (shown above) at `POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/sso/exchange` with body `{ "sso_jwt": "<token>" }` -> returns `{ "api_key": "rw_<...>", "expires_at": null }`. Use that `rw_` key in `Authorization: Bearer rw_<...>` and calls succeed.

zoe: Copying that into the message. Closing thread when customer confirms.
